input.subject: FINAL RELEASE LAUNCH | The Astorian — last 12 residences now available
input.bodyText:
Brokers,

The Astorian at 30-77 Steinway St, Astoria is releasing its FINAL 12 residences — available for purchase now. These are the last homes in the building and they are priced and contract-ready today.

1BR from $815,000
2BR from $1,240,000
3BR from $1,690,000

Closings for these final units projected Q2 2027 as the building completes its punch list, but contracts are being signed now at current pricing. Sales gallery open daily. 2.5% co-broke.

Nadia Rahman
The Astorian Sales Gallery
